Package game.positions.area

Class FreeTiles

java.lang.Object
game.positions.area.FreeTiles
public class FreeTiles extends Object
The tiles of one map that are still free while the game world is being set up, and the one rule for using them: something placed at random goes on a random free tile, and that tile is then taken.

Without this class, the world passed the map, a bare set of taken tiles, the RandomUtils and the AreaFactory together through every set-up method (a Data Clump), and any of those methods could change the set directly. The taken tiles are now private to this class and change only through its methods. Each map has its own FreeTiles, which rejects a tile from any other map, so the farm's taken tiles cannot be mixed up with the mines'. When no free tile is left, placing fails with an exception instead of searching forever.
